question: Which statement best describes Separate shared and changing content?
options: Wrap request-time work in a Suspense boundary with a fallback. The framework can include that fallback in the shell while dynamic content waits. Keep the boundary close to the work so unrelated content can appear sooner.

Shared content, such as navigation or a product description, may be prepared before a visit. User-specific details or current stock may require request-time work. Mark which parts can safely be reused. It is like setting the table before knowing which meal a guest orders.

As dynamic regions become ready, the server can stream their content into the page. Independent regions may resolve at different times. Make each region understandable while it is loading or unavailable.
The framework can render content that does not need request-time information into an initial shell. The shell should already help the visitor understand the page and available actions.
